entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: A human orphan accepted into the minotaur community of the Urhaalan Valley; bastard son of Peemel's fourth wife and Vervamon, who holds the Sigil of Iwset.

entities.name: Living Armor
entities.description: Armor that turns its wearer into a berserk killing machine.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: God of the minotaurs, represented by a stone idol and giant statue that kills once awakened.

entities.name: Niroso
entities.description: Liquid stone elementals manipulated by Sacumon to instigate the war.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A witch who manipulates the Niroso to start the war and tricks Yunnie into the Living Armor.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: Home of the minotaur community.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Home of the elves at war with the minotaurs.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Human soldier who protects Vervamon the Elder.

entities.name: Vervamon the Elder
entities.description: A scholar who wanders Terisiare writing about its history, cultures and geography; Yunnie's father.

entities.name: Lord Peemel of Iwset
entities.description: Lord who sends Maeveen's group to find the Sigil of Iwset and declares war on Jehesic.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: The missing seal of Peemel's office, held by Yunnie.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Character whose misspoken command turns Tiyint on the minotaurs.

entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: Neighboring island nation Peemel declares war on.

entities.name: Ferantia
entities.description: Advisor of Queen Edara who plots against her.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Queen of Jehesic.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Advisor to Peemel who tries to oust him; dies.

entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Advisor to Peemel; ends in charge of Jehesic with Edara.

entities.name: Ihesia
entities.description: Advisor to Peemel trying to oust him.

entities.name: Isak Glen'Dard
entities.description: A shapeshifter secretly working as a messenger for several sides.

entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: City ruled by Peemel.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane of the novel.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent Vervamon wanders.

events.summary: Yunnie is accepted into the minotaur community of the Urhaalan Valley and discovers a third party behind the war.
events.quote: Yunnie quickly discovers that there is a third party involved

events.summary: The Niroso, manipulated by Sacumon, burn elven and minotaur homes so each side blames the other.
events.quote: which the warring factions blame on each other

events.summary: Sacumon tricks Yunnie into donning the Living Armor and silences him.
events.quote: Sacumon tricks Yunnie into donning the Living Armor

events.summary: Peemel tasks Maeveen and Vervamon with finding the Sigil of Iwset.
events.quote: They get tasked by lord Peemel of Iwset to find the Sigil of Iwset

events.summary: The quest leads to the Urhaalan Valley, where Yunnie is revealed to hold the sigil as the son of Peemel's fourth wife and Vervamon.
events.quote: It turns out that Yunnie has this sigil

events.summary: Maeveen's group helps defeat Sacumon and end the war at great cost.
events.quote: Maeveen's group helps defeat Sacumon and end the war

events.summary: They animate a giant statue of Tiyint, which kills elves until Mytaru's misspoken command turns it on the minotaurs.
events.quote: Tiyint then turns on the minotaurs
Lord Peemel has declared war on the neighboring island nation of Jehesic

events.summary: Maeveen brings Yunnie to Iwset, resulting in the deaths of Peemel and Digody.
events.quote: which results in the death of Peemel and Digody

events.summary: Edara and Apepei are left in charge of Jehesic with a tenuous grip on Iwset.
events.quote: leaving Edara and Apepei in charge of Jehesic
